description: This file is a shell script library for managing common merge tool functions within a Git environment. It defines functions for checking mode, listing, configuring, and executing external merge tools, and handling tool configuration and invocation logic.

methods.name: mode_ok
methods.description: Checks if the current mode is either diff or merge.

methods.name: is_available
methods.description: Determines if a specified merge tool is available in the environment.

methods.name: list_config_tools
methods.description: Lists configured tools in git config under a specified section.

methods.name: show_tool_names
methods.description: Displays the list of merge or diff tools, filtered by condition.

methods.name: diff_mode
methods.description: Checks if the current mode is 'diff'.

methods.name: merge_mode
methods.description: Checks if the current mode is 'merge'.

methods.name: get_gui_default
methods.description: Determines default GUI mode setting based on configuration and environment.

methods.name: gui_mode
methods.description: Checks if GUI mode is enabled.

methods.name: translate_merge_tool_path
methods.description: Returns the path for a given merge tool.

methods.name: check_unchanged
methods.description: Verifies if the merged file has not changed post-merge, prompting user if needed.

methods.name: valid_tool
methods.description: Checks if a specified tool setup is valid and executable.

methods.name: setup_user_tool
methods.description: Configures a user-specified external merge tool.

methods.name: setup_tool
methods.description: Sets up the internal functions and configuration for a specified merge tool.

methods.name: get_merge_tool_cmd
methods.description: Retrieves the command associated with a merge tool.

methods.name: trust_exit_code
methods.description: Determines if the merge tool's exit code can be trusted.

methods.name: initialize_merge_tool
methods.description: Loads merge tool-specific functions into scope.

methods.name: run_merge_tool
methods.description: Executes the merge or diff tool based on the current mode.

methods.name: run_diff_cmd
methods.description: Runs a configured diff command.

methods.name: run_merge_cmd
methods.description: Runs a configured merge command, trusting or checking exit status.

methods.name: list_merge_tool_candidates
methods.description: Provides a list of possible merge tools based on environment and mode.

methods.name: show_tool_help
methods.description: Displays help information about available tools.

methods.name: guess_merge_tool
methods.description: Attempts to auto-detect an available merge tool.

methods.name: get_configured_merge_tool
methods.description: Retrieves the merge tool configured in Git settings.

methods.name: get_merge_tool_path
methods.description: Determines the executable path for a given merge tool.

methods.name: get_merge_tool
methods.description: Gets the merge tool to use, relying on configuration or guessing.

methods.name: mergetool_find_win32_cmd
methods.description: Finds an executable command in Windows environment, considering typical installation directories.
